newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid bourse ends up, further gains on horizon.
newsitem.headline: Madrid bourse ends up, further gains on horizon.

text.p: The Madrid bourse climbed to end close to historic highs on Friday boosted by gains in other stock markets and traders said the short-term outlook remained positive.
The general index rose 8.71 points, 1.54 percent, to 574.95, while the Ibex-35 index of leading shares climbed 101.75 points, 1.56 percent, to 6,616.15.
"Although the rise appears exaggerated, the market is proving very strong and you have to be in this market -- you just can't miss out on these opportunities," one trader said.
Traders said the market had resumed its upward trend and expected to see further gains next week.
Turnover was higher than seen in recent sessions with 110 billion pesetas changing hands.
Among individual stocks, Repsol saw the lion's share of activity largely due to a number of block trades. Repsol rose 60 pesetas to 6,350 with more than four million shares traded.
The banking sector performed well and Bankinter and Santander gained more than three percent.
